payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate verification hit an upstream compile blocker while running pnpm rust:backend:check from /Users/bri/dev/Crate: frick-server/src/config.rs currently imports client_ip::IpCidr but parse_trusted_proxy_cidrs collects IpCidr::parse results into the local Result<T> alias, producing E0107/E0277 because the iterator item error is String rather than FrickConfigError. This is in the same trusted client-IP/rate-limit area Crate needs for exact scan limiter parity.
